bibliographic.title: The Magician's Nephew
bibliographic.author: Mister Flibble
bibliographic.description:
The time has come to decide. Will you marry your fiancé or start a career as a magician (spoiler, the game is a lot shorter if you choose the marry option).

Recruit beautify assistants, perform grand illusions with them and get to know them a *lot* better!

(This is a re-release of a 2008 release, mostly lost to time.)

As a reviewer wrote: “I came for the sex, I stayed for the magic.”.

It has many multiple endings and multiple middles - in fact there are significant choices from the second scene.
